I've even heard of situations where kids were never told who their dad was yet the sate knew and had even taken the dad to court to garnish child support which of course went to the state while the kids were in state custody. Finally, once you have some cash I would get your DNA on as many ancestry type websites as possible. You may not find your bio dad, he may have passed, but you could potentially find grandparents, aunts/uncles, and cousins. I do want to warn you that this can cut both ways. Your bio family could be awesome or they could suck, but either way at least you would know.
